{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Suriname|Cuisine of Suriname]]

'''Kipspek''', which literally translates from Dutch into "chickenbacon", is a very easy snack consisting of cubed chicken wrapped in bacon, which is then breaded and fried.

==Ingredients==

* 1–2 [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken breasts]], [[Cookbook:Cube|cubed]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Pepper|Black pepper]]
* [[Cookbook:Bacon|Bacon]] strips
* 1–2 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
* Fine powdery [[Cookbook:Bread Crumb|breadcrumbs]]
* [[Cookbook:Skewer|Toothpicks]]
* [[Cookbook:Oil|Oil]]

==Procedure==
# Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
# Wrap each cube of chicken in a strip of bacon.
# To make sure the bacon doesn't roll off the chicken, stick a toothpick from one end to the other.
# Roll the kipspek in the breadcrumbs.
# [[Cookbook:Whisk|Whisk]] the eggs, and dip each kipspek in the eggs.
# Roll the kipspek through the breadcrumbs once again. Leave them for about half an hour to dry out the surface.
# Heat the oil in a deep pot.
# [[Cookbook:Frying|Fry]] the kipspeks until they're golden brown all over. 
# Serve with ketchup or mustard—don't forget to remove the toothpick before taking a bite.
